batting.name: FH Allen
batting.dismissal: c P Simran Singh b XC Bartlett

batting.name: C Green
batting.dismissal: c P Simran Singh b XC Bartlett

balls.text: fullish on middle and leg. Rahane gets onto the front foot and pokes it to mid wicket

length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi comes half forward and prods it to mid off. Shreyas then fires a throw at the bowler's end and misses, and the backing-up is not quite up to scratch. Jansen, sliding to stop the throw, actually ends up parrying it past fine leg. Four bonus runs!
full just outside off. Raghuvanshi gets onto the front foot and defends. Bartlett continuing to get swing
full just outside off. Shapes away nicely and Raghuvanshi, coming down the track, pats it back to the bowler
back of a length on the pads. Raghuvanshi tucks it off his hips towards long leg and retains strike
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi thinks about playing at it before bailing out of it at the last moment
back of a length on middle and off. Rahane drops it behind point with soft hands and picks up another single
back of a length on middle and leg, shaping in. Raghuvanshi comes half forward and stabs it into the on side
back of a length outside off. Goes on with the angle and Raghuvanshi, skipping down, opts to not play at it at the last moment
back of a length outside off. Rahane waits on it before running it down to deep backward point

another nick, and another wicket! Bartlett on fire, and KKR on the ropes early! Back of a length in the channel and this boomerangs away from Green. He goes feeling for it away from his body and nicks it through to the keeper. Bartlett putting on an exhibition of out-swing early, and KKR stung twice in the same over!
edged and four! Bartlett causing a whole world of problems for the KKR batters. Fullish outside off, moving away again. Green chases after it and edges it past short third!

nicked and gone! Bartlett had Allen on toast throughout, and he now sends him back to the shed! This is beautiful bowling. On a length just outside off. Curves away late and Allen, trying to go inside-out, only manages a feather. Regulation catch for the keeper, and Bartlett has the early breakthrough his efforts have warranted!
length outside off and this swerves away too. Allen swishes at it and misses

proper chaos out in the middle! Back of a length delivery wide outside off. Allen shapes for the scoop by walking a mile across. Makes a mess of it and the miscue lands in front of the keeper, who fields it and then hurls a throw into his teammate while trying to hit the stumps. Comedy of errors!
fullish outside off and this carves away late. Allen tries to smash this into the sightscreen but only connects with fresh air
low full toss on middle and off. Not a whole lot of swing this time and Allen jabs it to mid off for a single
streaky but more runs! In-swinging yorker on leg. Allen jams his bat down just in time and the ball flies off the inside edge into the fine leg fence!
length outside off, shaping away again. Rahane comes forward and opens his bat face to dab it towards deep backward point
nicely done! Back of a length outside off. Rahane uses the swing away from him and guides it between short third and slip!
back of a length, starting outside leg and shaping away. Allen drops it into the off side and gets off the mark
fullish and shaping into the pads. Rahane plays all around it and the ball rolls off his thigh pad into the on side. Given as runs. Maybe Rahane did get a scratch on it
